source.expr: ppg + rpg + apg + spg + bpg + tov + fgm + fga + tpm + tpa

shot_diet_gap.make:
no_score * 0.60 + scoreable
  * max(0, (tpa/max(1e-6,fga)) - 0.70)
  * max(0, 1.28 - ((fga - tpa))) / 1.28
  * max(0, pps_fg - 1.22)
  * min(1, 10/max(1e-6,fga))
shot_diet_gap.label: Shot Diet Gap

baseline.description: Each normalized metric at 0.5; a reference, not the cohort average.

explanation_context.rounding: Python round: nearest integer, ties to even
explanation_context.bucket_aggregation: Unweighted means of nonzero primary-weight metrics; not additive points.
explanation_context.attribution: Contributions explain the weighted sum before clipping and profile scaling.
explanation_context.model_notice: A model-based evaluation under this adapter, weights and cohort.
